22: BBbbbbbBBBBBBggggggggggggggggSSSSBB

So the tip changed from `SSbb` to `bbbb` on rows 19-20 and `SSSS` on rows 21-22. The tip moved UP! The blue part (bb) moved up and the sky-blue part (SS) moved down.
